kind: Controlled EditMode real RaceCanvas HUD.RequestInRaceAction preview. No gameplay manager, live match, scene loading or settings persistence.
lifecycle: Disabled project behaviours; HUD.Start invoked explicitly on owned prefab clone. Isolated all-confirmations settings object, exact previous current/repository restored. Owned modal button listeners are rebound only to original HUD handlers after Start, isolating ButtonClickAnimation audio side effects; real cancel and confirm handlers use counter callbacks. Native Selectable protected DoStateTransition instant=true supplies after-state visuals; disabled also sets interactable=false. One explicitly synthetic long-copy stress fixture. Fonts/materials cloned as static; no saved scenes or source font mutation.
